title: Icon #2 Milestone DC Comics 1993 Rocket Early Issue Direct Edition McDuffie
conditionDescription: Two copies available; both in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos.
descriptionText:
Icon #2 (June 1993, Milestone Media / DC Comics) -- second issue of Dwayne McDuffie and M.D. Bright's Icon, "Stop! Do Not Hop on Cop!" with Icon and Rocket. Direct sales edition. Cover price $1.50 US.

Condition: Two copies available; both in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copies being sold.
